_ghi: Ý nghĩa 12 nhà NGUYÊN VĂN của astrolas.com (hệ cổ điển — trang Annual Profections, ô giải nghĩa nhà của năm), lấy 04/11/2026 bằng cách đổi year_target trên https://astrolas.com/annual-profections-v1. Máy viết lời (lich-su/dai/sinh-chuong.mjs, G5) chỉ được dùng chữ ở đây, không tự đặt nghĩa nhà.

nha.1: The body, physical health, spirit, new beginnings, and core personal matters.
nha.2: Livelihood, income, personal assets, financial transactions (giving and receiving).
nha.3: Siblings, neighbors, short trips, religion, dreams, and kinship relations.
nha.4: Parents (especially the father), family, home, real estate, private matters, and the ending of things.
nha.5: Children, creativity, joy, enjoyment, and acts of charity.
nha.6: Illness, injuries, hardship, subordinates, servants (or pets), and physical challenges.
nha.7: Marriage, spouse, business partners, external relations, and going abroad.
nha.8: Death, inheritance, benefits from the death of others, stagnation, or punishments.
nha.9: Long-distance travel, foreign lands, philosophy, religion, astrology, prophecy, and higher education.
nha.10: Career, action (praxis), reputation, social status, advancement, and public achievements.
nha.11: Friends, hopes, dreams, gifts, and patronage from those in power.
nha.12: Hidden enemies, calamities, imprisonment, injuries, suffering, and matters relating to foreign lands (of a negative nature).
